etymologies.heading: Etymology
paragraphs: Borrowed from French façade, from Italian facciata, a derivation of faccia (“front”), from Latin faciēs (“face”); compare face.
senses: (architecture) The face of a building, especially the front view or elevation.
(by extension) The face or front (most visible side) of any other thing, such as the prospect of an organ.
(figurative, transitive, rare) To cover or disguise an outward appearance.
